import json,collections
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)
for item,answer in zip(items,answers):
 assert item['item_id']==answer['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,item['slots']+1)}
 assert set(answer['slots'])==expected
 assert set(answer['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in answer['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in answer['confidence'].values())
 assert answer['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(answer['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
counts=collections.Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items,',sum(counts.values()),'slots')
print({v:counts[v] for v in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
